name: Fast Aid [Psionic]
body:
Requests to you for healing can be made much faster.

Prerequisite: Heal 7 ranks, Spellcraft 7 ranks, request aid class feature.

Benefit: Your allies may choose to request aid as a swift action.

Normal: Request aid costs a standard action to perform.
